content.content: Implement and verify the lifecycle-owned two-checkpoint artifact handoff contract, deterministic Work Unit admission gate, and durable post-start execution continuation contract accepted in the source Intake.

content: Add lifecycle-owned deterministic checkpoint creation and read-only inspection commands with a shared receipt contract.
Validate owning Intake and Work Unit packages before Git or execution-state mutation.
Enforce exact staged-file isolation, path and symlink safety, race detection, failure cleanup, and replay recovery.
Use the inspected second checkpoint commit as the execution worktree base.
Mechanically couple a deterministic full-ready admission gate to the earliest worktree mutation boundary.
Persist versioned step progress and resume the same revision and attempt after interruption without repeating settled decisions.
Implement idempotent retry identity, bounded transient retry, evidence-backed blocked outcomes, and blocker-resolution resume.
Update active lifecycle, intake, planner, and execution skill contracts and add focused and regression tests.
General backup policy or existing Git history rewrite
Artifact JSON schema or profile redesign beyond the approved durable execution item contract
Work Unit result integration, worktree cleanup, push, publication, marketplace mutation, reinstall, or PR promotion
Lifecycle and Intake skill contract updates for two explicit Human-approved checkpoints
Planner manager and documentation changes for full-ready admission, durable progress, retry, and blocked recovery
Worktree manager and execution documentation changes for package-aware pre-mutation refusal and inspected checkpoint base
Focused, regression, temporary-repository, and plugin validation evidence
